answers.core: Grids are a very common method of displaying _groups of related objects_ in menus (ex: Inventory slots, Level selects, Menu options). Giving users more options to customize grids in menus allow menus to become more _flexible_ (especially on much _smaller, wider screens_).
answers.workaround:
- By default, GridContainer works the same as before (when _vertical_ is left _true_ by default).
- Any grid can be represented by a VBoxContainer and a series of HBoxContainers (although GridContainers save a lot of headache accessing children nodes!).
